result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with a continuous sidewalk on the right side, though it shows signs of wear and cracking. The environment lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure at the visible intersection, such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or pedestrian signals, relying instead on a stop-controlled approach for cross-traffic.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, making pedestrian movements less predictable to drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and mature vegetation along the curb may obscure pedestrians waiting to cross.

hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface has visible cracks and uneven sections that could pose a tripping hazard.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the intersection corners to improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: This residential street features a narrow sidewalk on one side with visible cracking and no marked pedestrian crossings. While the low-speed environment is typical for a neighborhood, the lack of formal crossing infrastructure and sightline obstructions from tall hedges reduce overall pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface on the left is cracked and uneven, which can be a trip hazard or barrier for those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and midground on the left side.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, requiring pedestrians to cross the wide roadway without clear priority or visibility aids.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Tall hedges along the left sidewalk may obscure pedestrians from the view of drivers exiting driveways or approaching intersections.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the property line.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Widening
interventions.description: Resurface and widen the existing sidewalk to meet modern accessibility standards and provide a smoother walking path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the nearest intersection to provide a safe and visible crossing point.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at intersections to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.

result.summary: The image shows a residential environment that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure, such as sidewalks and marked crossings. The wide, unmarked roadway forces pedestrians to share space with vehicles, increasing the risk of conflict.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: There are no dedicated pedestrian walkways, forcing people to walk in the roadway with vehicular traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the edges of the roadway throughout the scene

hazards.name: Excessive Roadway Width
hazards.description: The wide, unmarked asphalt surface encourages higher vehicle speeds and creates long, unprotected crossing distances.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the image

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Visible cracking and degradation of the asphalt surface can create trip hazards.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to separate pedestrians from motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Road Diet / Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the effective width of the roadway through striping or physical curb extensions to slow traffic and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.
